description: KPI Tree is a powerful visual that lets you display multiple KPI cards in an expandable and collapsible hierarchy—perfect for showing how key metrics are distributed and aggregated across organizational structures, product lines, regions, or any multi-level category. Instead of a flat layout or matrix, KPI Tree organizes your KPIs into a dynamic tree view, making it easy to drill down through hierarchical levels for detail or collapse branches to maintain a clean overview. Each node in the tree represents a KPI card, which can display actual and target values (or any two comparable measures), along with a visual indicator that highlights the variance—ranging from directional symbols to customizable icons. For additional insight, each card can include mini charts that visualize trends for actual and target values or their variance over time. KPI Tree is fully interactive: selecting any node can filter or highlight other visuals in your report. The visual adapts dynamically to your data model and supports extensive formatting options for KPI cards and indicators—ensuring clarity and impact even in large, complex structures. Whether you want to track performance across business units or explore KPIs by category and subcategory, KPI Tree gives you a structured, intuitive way to present key metrics in context.
